label: FreeSurfer mris_convert
description:
Convert a surface to GIFTI without modifying the source.

The interface exposes the typed options listed below; the original installed-version help is retained in source references.

input_slots.label: surface
input_slots.description: Input FreeSurfer surface or supported surface format.

output_slots.label: surface
output_slots.description: Native command output, saved in this run’s output directory. Convert a surface to GIFTI without modifying the source. This generic file port does not establish a specialized scientific artifact type; downstream use must match the documented contents, not merely the filename extension.

omitted_options.other_options: Only the documented options below are exposed. Consult the installed-version help for other syntax; arbitrary arguments are not accepted.
